messages.content: Hey, this is your weekly Northline check-in for pt-1005. How's your blood sugar been running? Any readings or concerns to pass along this week?
Honestly pretty frustrated right now. Insurance denied my test strip claim again and now I'm completely out. Can't even check my levels.

That sounds genuinely maddening, and I'm sorry you're dealing with it. I have to be straight with you though — insurance claims are outside what I'm able to help with here. That'll need to go through your provider's billing office or the insurance company directly. Before we move on, what was your last reading before you ran out of strips?
Monday morning it was 218. Haven't been able to check since then, that was four days ago.

I'm logging that 218 from Monday morning. Going four days without being able to monitor, with a reading at that level, is something your nurse needs to see. I'm sending a flag to the care team now — just so you know, median response time is currently 31 hours. Anything else you want me to add to that note?
Just that I really need those strips sorted. I'm out here kind of flying blind.
I've included that in the note — that you're without strips and haven't been able to monitor since Monday. Your nurse will see it. Your next check-in is scheduled for next Tuesday. Hang in there.
